mainTopic: The order of the daily Temple service: אביי's sequence from the תמיד to the בזיכין, the dispute over מוספין and בזיכין, and the placement of the morning and afternoon קטורת.
overview: This amud finishes אביי's list of the order of the Temple service, giving a reason for each link. The תמיד של שחר comes first, followed by its מנחה, then the חביתין, the נסכים, the מוספין, and finally the בזיכין. A ברייתא puts the בזיכין before the מוספין, and the גמרא answers that this is a מחלוקת תנאים. אביי argues that his side is more logical, because "ביום ביום" teaches that the בזיכין are pushed later. The other side learns the בזיכין from the חביתין through the shared word "חוקה." It still uses "ביום ביום" to delay them until after the נסכים. The גמרא then returns to the משנה and explains that the morning קטורת came between the blood and the limbs. This follows רבנן, even though the משנה leaves the lamps out. רבי יוחנן derives from a פסוק that the afternoon קטורת comes before the נסכים, but not before the limbs. A ברייתא then teaches that the morning תמיד learns its נסכים from the afternoon one.

steps.title: The morning תמיד is the first offering on the מזבח
steps.stepSummary: The פסוק ״וערך עליה העולה״ shows, as רבא explains, that the תמיד של שחר is the first offering placed on the מזבח.
steps.simpleTranslation: The verse says: "And he shall arrange the burnt-offering upon it." רבא said: "The burnt-offering" means the one that goes up first.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a פסוק to prove that the morning תמיד must be the very first offering on the מזבח each day.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פסוק could have just said "he shall arrange upon it." Instead it says "THE עולה," with the word "the." רבא reads that word as pointing to the main, first עולה of the day, which is the תמיד של שחר. This sets the anchor for the whole chain that follows: the תמיד comes first, and everything else lines up after it.

keyTerms.meaning: "The verse teaches": introduces the פסוק that serves as the source
"And he shall arrange upon it": placing offerings on the מזבח
"The" burnt-offering, which here means the תמיד
The first עולה, the one that goes up before anything else

steps.whyThisMatters: Every later step in אביי's order depends on the תמיד being first. The מנחה and נסכים come next because they belong to the תמיד.

phrases.english: The verse states:
"And he shall arrange the burnt-offering upon it"
and Rava said:
"The burnt-offering" means it goes up first.
phrases.notes: The extra ה׳ הידיעה ("the") points to the primary, first עולה.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the earlier part of the daf, giving the scriptural source that nothing comes before the תמיד של שחר.
steps.raayaObject: That the תמיד של שחר is the first offering on the מזבח.
steps.raayaSupportSource: ויקרא ו:ה ״וערך עליה העולה״, read by רבא.

steps.title: The meal-offering comes before the griddle-cake offering
steps.stepSummary: אביי rules that the מנחה of the תמיד comes before the כהן גדול's חביתין, based on the פסוק's order "עולה ומנחה."
steps.simpleTranslation: And the meal-offering comes before the griddle-cakes, because the verse says "burnt-offering and meal-offering."
steps.whatsHappening: אביי gives the next link in the chain: the מנחה that comes with the תמיד is offered before the חביתין.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פסוק (ויקרא כג:לז) lists "עולה ומנחה" side by side, so the מנחה is attached to the עולה. Since the מנחה is part of the תמיד's package, it follows right after the תמיד. It therefore comes before the חביתין, which is a separate offering not connected to the תמיד.

keyTerms.meaning: Meal-offering; here, the one that accompanies the תמיד
The כהן גדול's daily griddle-cake offering, brought half in the morning and half in the afternoon

phrases.english: And the meal-offering comes before the griddle-cakes,
because it says "burnt-offering and meal-offering."
phrases.notes: This is ויקרא כג:לז, where the מנחה is listed right next to the עולה.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Builds on the תמיד being first, and places its מנחה right after it.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: מנחה of the תמיד precedes the חביתין.

steps.title: The griddle-cakes come before the libations
steps.stepSummary: The חביתין come before the נסכים because the חביתין belong to the category of מנחה.
steps.simpleTranslation: And the griddle-cakes come before the libations, because they carry the name "meal-offering."
steps.whatsHappening: אביי gives the next link: the חביתין are offered before the נסכים (wine libations) of the תמיד.
steps.deeperAnalysis: We already know that "מנחה" follows directly after the עולה. Since the חביתין are also a type of מנחה, they share that early place. That puts them ahead of the נסכים.

keyTerms.meaning: Wine libations poured with an offering
"The name/category of מנחה": it counts as a meal-offering

steps.confusionAlert: The נסכים here are the תמיד's own libations, yet the חביתין still come before them. The reason is the category of מנחה, not whether an offering belongs to the תמיד.

phrases.english: And the griddle-cakes come before the libations,
because they are in the category of meal-offering.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Extends the rule that מנחה follows עולה to cover the חביתין as well.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: חביתין precede the נסכים because they are a מנחה.

steps.title: The libations come before the additional offerings
steps.stepSummary: The נסכים come before the מוספין, based on the פסוק's phrase "זבח ונסכים."
steps.simpleTranslation: And the libations come before the additional offerings, because the verse says "sacrifice and libations."
steps.whatsHappening: אביי gives the next link: the תמיד's נסכים are poured before the מוספין of שבת or יום טוב are offered.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The same פסוק says "זבח ונסכים," which joins the libations to the sacrifice. So the נסכים belong right after the תמיד, before any other animal offering. That means they come before the מוספין.

keyTerms.meaning: The additional offerings brought on שבת, ראש חודש, and יום טוב
"Sacrifice and libations": the phrase linking the נסכים to the sacrifice

phrases.english: And the libations come before the additional offerings,
because it says "sacrifice and libations."

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the chain, placing the נסכים before the מוספין.

steps.title: The additional offerings come before the frankincense bowls
steps.stepSummary: אביי states that the מוספין come before the בזיכין of לבונה offered on שבת.
steps.simpleTranslation: And the additional offerings come before the bowls of frankincense.
steps.whatsHappening: אביי states the last link in this part of the chain: the מוספין come before the בזיכין. This sets up the challenge in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: No reason is given here. It is simply אביי's ruling on the order. The very next line will test this ruling against a ברייתא that says the opposite.

keyTerms.meaning: The two bowls of לבונה (frankincense) that sat with the לחם הפנים and were burned on שבת

phrases.english: And the additional offerings come before the frankincense bowls.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Next item in אביי's order, which the following step will challenge.

steps.title: A ברייתא says the frankincense bowls come first
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא challenges אביי from a ברייתא stating that the בזיכין come before the מוספין.
steps.simpleTranslation: But wasn't it taught in a ברייתא: the frankincense bowls come before the additional offerings!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא raises a contradiction: a ברייתא teaches the reverse of what אביי just said.
steps.deeperAnalysis: אביי said that the מוספין come first and then the בזיכין. The ברייתא says that the בזיכין come first and then the מוספין. If the ברייתא is the accepted teaching, אביי's order seems wrong.

keyTerms.meaning: "But wasn't it taught in a ברייתא?": introduces a contradicting source
"Come first, precede"

phrases.english: But wasn't it taught: the frankincense bowls come before the additional offerings!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Attacks the ruling of step 5.
steps.kashyaTarget: אביי's ruling that the מוספין precede the בזיכין.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: A ברייתא explicitly states the reverse order.

steps.title: This is a dispute between תנאים
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא answers that the order of the מוספין and the בזיכין is a מחלוקת תנאים, and אביי follows the other side.
steps.simpleTranslation: It is a dispute between תנאים.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא resolves the contradiction by saying that the ברייתא reflects only one opinion among the תנאים. אביי holds like the other opinion.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The גמרא does not say that אביי or the ברייתא is mistaken. It explains that the תנאים themselves disagreed about this order. According to one explanation, the disputants are רבי ישמעאל and רבי עקיבא, discussed in מסכת פסחים. So אביי is allowed to follow the opinion that does not match the ברייתא.

keyTerms.meaning: "It is a dispute of תנאים": each source follows a different opinion

steps.whatToRemember: אביי's order runs: תמיד first, then מנחה, then חביתין, then נסכים, then מוספין, then בזיכין. Each link has a reason. The last link, מוספין before בזיכין, is disputed among the תנאים.

phrases.english: It is a dispute of Tannaim.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the קשיא of step 6.
steps.terutzResolutionType: מחלוקת תנאים: the contradicting source reflects a different tannaitic opinion.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The ברייתא seemed to be the only view, which would make אביי's order wrong.
steps.terutzMaskana: The ברייתא is only one side of a tannaitic dispute, and אביי follows the other side.

steps.title: אביי explains why his view makes sense
steps.stepSummary: אביי supports the view that the מוספין come before the בזיכין. Just as "בבקר בבקר" teaches 'do it first,' "ביום ביום" teaches 'do it later.'
steps.simpleTranslation: אביי said: It makes sense to follow the one who says the מוספין come before the בזיכין. Don't you say that "in the morning, in the morning" means 'put it first'? Here too, "on the day, on the day" means 'put it later.'
steps.whatsHappening: אביי has just been shown to follow one side of a מחלוקת תנאים. Now he gives a reason why his side is the more logical one.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The תורה says "בבקר בבקר" about the morning service, and we learned from it that the תמיד comes first. About the בזיכין the פסוק says "ביום השבת ביום השבת." "Day" suggests the full part of the day, not early morning, so the בזיכין are pushed later, after the מוספין.

keyTerms.meaning: It makes sense / it is logical
The bowls of לבונה (frankincense) burned on שבת
The extra קרבנות brought on שבת and יום טוב
To put first
To push later

steps.whyThisMatters: This explains what the phrase "ביום ביום" teaches, and that phrase comes back again in Step 12.

phrases.english: Abaye said:
It is reasonable to follow the one who says
the additional offerings come before the bowls of frankincense
Didn't you say
that "in the morning, in the morning" comes to put it first?
phrases.notes: Said about the תמיד, which comes before everything else.

phrases.english: Here too:
"on the day," "on the day" comes to put it later.
phrases.notes: ויקרא כד:ח, about arranging the לחם הפנים and בזיכין on שבת.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: After Step 7 showed אביי follows one side of a מחלוקת תנאים, אביי explains why that side is logical.
steps.raayaObject: The view that מוספין come before בזיכין
steps.raayaSupportSource: Comparing "בבקר בבקר" (put first) with "ביום ביום" (put later)

steps.title: What is the reason for the other view?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks for the source of the view that the בזיכין come before the מוספין.
steps.simpleTranslation: What is the reason of the one who says the בזיכין come before the מוספין?
steps.whatsHappening: After hearing אביי's reason, the גמרא now asks for the other side's reason. This sets up the answer in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The other view seems to go against the "ביום ביום" logic, so we need to know what source it relies on.

keyTerms.meaning: What is the reason?
The one who says (a view)

phrases.english: What is the reason of the one who says
the bowls of frankincense come before the additional offerings?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Turns from אביי's side to the opposing side's source.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The source for putting בזיכין before מוספין

steps.title: The other view learns from the חביתין
steps.stepSummary: The other view compares the word "חוקה" used for the בזיכין with "חוקה" used for the חביתין. Since the חביתין come before the מוספין, the בזיכין do too.
steps.simpleTranslation: He learns "statute" from "statute" written about the חביתין.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the question by giving the other view's source, a גזירה שוה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The word "חוקה" appears with the בזיכין (ויקרא כד:ט) and with the חביתין (ויקרא ו:טו). Matching words connect the two. So the בזיכין are placed early like the חביתין, before the מוספין.

keyTerms.meaning: He learns (from a comparison)
"Statute", the word that links the two cases
The daily griddle-cake מנחה of the כהן גדול
Learning a law from the same word appearing in two places

phrases.english: He learns "statute" from "statute" written about the griddle-cake offering.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question of Step 9.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: A גזירה שוה of "חוקה" from the חביתין, which come before the מוספין

steps.title: Then learn the whole order from the חביתין
steps.stepSummary: If the בזיכין are learned from the חביתין, they should come right after the חביתין, before the נסכים too.
steps.simpleTranslation: If he learns from there, let him learn the whole matter from there!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges the answer just given. If the comparison is real, why does it work only halfway?
steps.deeperAnalysis: The order is חביתין, then נסכים, then מוספין. If the בזיכין are fully compared to the חביתין, they should come right after the חביתין, before the נסכים. But this view places the נסכים in between.

keyTerms.meaning: Let him learn it
The whole matter

phrases.english: If he learns it from there,
let him learn the whole matter from there?

steps.triggerLanguage: אִי מֵהָתָם גָּמַר, לִיגְמְרַהּ כּוּלַּהּ מִילְּתָא מֵהָתָם
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Attacks the גזירה שוה of Step 10 for being applied only partly.
steps.kashyaTarget: The comparison of בזיכין to חביתין
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: A full comparison would place the בזיכין right after the חביתין, before the נסכים.

steps.title: "ביום ביום" delays the בזיכין a little
steps.stepSummary: The phrase "ביום ביום" pushes the בזיכין somewhat later, after the נסכים, while the חביתין comparison still keeps them before the מוספין.
steps.simpleTranslation: For this, "on the day, on the day" helps: to put it later.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that both sources work together. The comparison keeps the בזיכין early, and "ביום ביום" pushes them back one step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This view agrees that "ביום ביום" means 'later,' like אביי said in Step 8. It just uses that delay to place the בזיכין after the נסכים, not after the מוספין. So the order is חביתין, נסכים, בזיכין, מוספין.

keyTerms.meaning: For this purpose
It is effective / it helps

steps.whatToRemember: Both views use "ביום ביום" to delay the בזיכין. אביי's view delays them until after the מוספין. The other view, which also uses the חביתין comparison, delays them only until after the נסכים.

phrases.english: For this it is effective:
"on the day," "on the day" — to put it later.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge of Step 11.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The בזיכין should come right after the חביתין.
steps.terutzMaskana: "ביום ביום" delays them past the נסכים. The חביתין comparison still keeps them before the מוספין.

steps.title: Back to the משנה about the morning קטורת
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes the משנה: the morning קטורת was offered between the blood and the limbs of the תמיד.
steps.simpleTranslation: The morning incense was offered between the blood and the limbs, etc.
steps.whatsHappening: The side discussion is over, and the גמרא returns to the words of the משנה. This quote sets up the question in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה says the קטורת came after the blood of the תמיד was sprinkled and before its limbs were burned. The גמרא will examine whether this wording fits a known opinion.

keyTerms.meaning: The incense offering
Morning
The limbs of the תמיד burned on the מזבח

phrases.english: The morning incense
was offered
between the blood and the limbs, etc.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Leaves אביי's order discussion and returns to the משנה.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The morning קטורת is offered between the blood and the limbs of the תמיד.

steps.title: The משנה's wording fits neither רבנן nor אבא שאול
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks whose opinion the משנה follows. רבנן would say 'between blood and lamps.' אבא שאול would say 'between lamps and limbs.'
steps.simpleTranslation: Whose view is this? If רבנן, it should say 'between the blood and the lamps.' If אבא שאול, it should say 'between the lamps and the limbs'!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges the משנה's wording. Neither known opinion would phrase it this way.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The fixing of the last two lamps of the מנורה also happens in this stretch of the service. For רבנן the order is blood, קטורת, lamps, so the משנה should mention the lamps after the קטורת. For אבא שאול it is blood, lamps, קטורת, limbs, so the משנה should mention the lamps before it.

keyTerms.meaning: Whose view is it?
The Sages (majority view)
A תנא who disagrees with רבנן about the order
The lamps of the מנורה (cleaning and preparing them)
It should have said

steps.confusionAlert: The question is not about whether the קטורת is between blood and limbs. Both views agree on that. The problem is that each view would name the lamps as one of the two edges, and the משנה names neither.

phrases.english: Whose view is it? If it is the Rabbis,
it should have said "between the blood and the lamps."
If it is Abba Shaul,
it should have said "between the lamps and the limbs"!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the wording of the משנה quoted in Step 13.
steps.kashyaTarget: The phrase "בין דם לאיברים" in the משנה
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Both רבנן and אבא שאול place the lamps right next to the קטורת. So the משנה should have named the lamps as one edge, not the blood or the limbs alone.

steps.title: The משנה follows רבנן but is not listing the full order
steps.stepSummary: The משנה follows רבנן. It simply is not describing the complete sequence of services.
steps.simpleTranslation: Really, it is the view of רבנן, and it is not talking about the full order.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the question from Step 14 about whose view the משנה follows. It says the משנה is רבנן's view.
steps.deeperAnalysis: According to רבנן, the last two lamps are prepared after the קטורת, between the קטורת and the limbs. That is why Step 14 said a רבנן version should read 'between the blood and the lamps.' The משנה simply leaves the lamps out, because it only wants to say that the קטורת comes after the blood and before the limbs. It is not trying to list every service in between.

keyTerms.meaning: Really / actually (introduces the answer that keeps the original assumption)
The order / sequence
It is not speaking about

phrases.english: Really, it is the view of the Rabbis,
and it is not speaking about the full sequence.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the attribution question of Step 14
steps.terutzResolutionType: Limits the scope of the משנה's wording: it is not a complete list
steps.terutzHavaAmina: We thought the משנה was listing every service, so it could fit neither רבנן nor אבא שאול
steps.terutzMaskana: The משנה follows רבנן and only fixes the קטורת between blood and limbs, without mentioning the lamps

steps.title: The משנה on the afternoon incense
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes the next part of the משנה. The afternoon קטורת was offered between the limbs and the נסכים.
steps.simpleTranslation: And the afternoon one was offered between the limbs and the libations, etc.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא quotes the next line of the משנה. This sets up the next move: asking for its source.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The afternoon order is different from the morning order. In the afternoon, the limbs come first, then the קטורת, then the נסכים.

keyTerms.meaning: Afternoon
The limbs of the תמיד, placed on the מזבח
Wine libations

phrases.english: And the afternoon [incense] was offered
between the limbs and the libations, etc.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves on from the morning קטורת to the afternoon קטורת
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The afternoon קטורת comes between the limbs and the נסכים

steps.title: What is the source for the afternoon order
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks where this order comes from.
steps.simpleTranslation: From where do we know these things?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks for the source of the afternoon order in the משנה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This is a plain request for a source, not an attack. It sets up רבי יוחנן's answer.

keyTerms.meaning: From where do we know these things?

phrases.english: From where are these matters derived?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Asks for the source of the משנה just quoted
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The biblical source showing the afternoon קטורת comes before the נסכים

steps.title: רבי יוחנן learns it from the morning offering
steps.stepSummary: רבי יוחנן brings the verse "כמנחת הבקר וכנסכו תעשה". In the morning the קטורת comes before the נסכים, so in the afternoon it does too.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי יוחנן said: the verse says, "Like the morning offering and its libation you shall do." In the morning the incense comes before the libations, and so here too the incense comes before the libations.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי יוחנן answers the question. He compares the afternoon תמיד to the morning one.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The verse about the afternoon lamb says to do it "like the morning offering and its libation." In the morning, the קטורת is offered before the נסכים. So the afternoon must also have the קטורת before the נסכים.

keyTerms.meaning: An אמורא who gives the source
Like the morning offering
Incense
Comes first / precedes

phrases.english: Rabbi Yochanan said: because the verse says:
"Like the morning meal-offering and its libation you shall do" (במדבר כח:ח),
just as with the morning offering
the incense precedes the libations,
so too here, the incense precedes the libations.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the source question
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The verse compares the afternoon תמיד to the morning one, where the קטורת precedes the נסכים

steps.title: Then the afternoon incense should also come before the limbs
steps.stepSummary: If the afternoon copies the morning, the קטורת should come before the limbs too, as it does in the morning.
steps.simpleTranslation: If so, just as there the incense comes before the limbs, here too the incense should come before the limbs!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges רבי יוחנן's comparison. It says the comparison should go further.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In the morning, the קטורת is offered before the limbs. If the afternoon is fully like the morning, the afternoon קטורת should also come before the limbs. But the משנה says it comes after them.

keyTerms.meaning: If so, just as there...
So too here

phrases.english: If so, just as there [in the morning]
the incense precedes the limbs,
so too here the incense should precede the limbs!

steps.triggerLanguage: אִי מָה לְהַלָּן קְטוֹרֶת קוֹדֶמֶת לְאֵיבָרִים
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Attacks the comparison made in Step 18
steps.kashyaTarget: רבי יוחנן's comparison of afternoon to morning
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: A full comparison would also put the קטורת before the limbs, which contradicts the משנה

steps.title: The verse compares only to the morning meal-offering, not the limbs
steps.stepSummary: The verse says "כמנחת הבקר", not "like the morning limbs." So the comparison covers only the order relative to the מנחה and נסכים, not the limbs.
steps.simpleTranslation: Is it written "like the morning limbs"? It is written "like the morning offering." Like the morning offering, and not like the morning limbs.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the challenge by reading the exact words of the verse.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The verse only names the morning מנחה and its נסכים. So the afternoon copies the morning only in that part: the קטורת comes before the נסכים. The limbs are not part of the comparison, so in the afternoon they can come before the קטורת.

keyTerms.meaning: Is it written...? (the verse does not say that)
Like the morning limbs

steps.whatToRemember: Morning order: blood, then קטורת, then limbs. Afternoon order: limbs, then קטורת, then נסכים. In both, the קטורת comes before the נסכים, because the verse compares only to the morning מנחה and נסכים.

phrases.english: Is it written "like the morning limbs"?
"Like the morning meal-offering" is written.
Like the morning meal-offering, and not like the morning limbs.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge of Step 19
steps.terutzResolutionType: Precise reading of the verse limits the scope of the comparison
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The afternoon copies the morning in everything, including the limbs
steps.terutzMaskana: The afternoon copies only the morning מנחה and נסכים, so the קטורת precedes the נסכים but not the limbs

steps.title: The morning offering learns its libations from the afternoon
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא teaches that "ונסכו רביעית ההין" refers to the afternoon תמיד. The morning תמיד learns from it.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבנן taught: "And its libation is a quarter of a הין." The morning one is learned from the evening one.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a ברייתא that opens a new point. Here the morning תמיד learns from the afternoon one.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Before this, the afternoon learned from the morning. Now the ברייתא shows the learning also goes the other way. The verse about the נסכים is read as speaking of the afternoon תמיד, and from it we learn that the morning תמיד also needs נסכים.

keyTerms.meaning: The Rabbis taught (introduces a ברייתא)
A quarter of a הין (the measure of wine)
Morning
Evening / afternoon

phrases.english: The Rabbis taught:
"And its libation is a quarter of a hin" (במדבר כח:ז)
the morning one shall be learned from the evening one.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Shows the reverse direction of learning between the two תמידין
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The morning תמיד learns its נסכים from the afternoon תמיד
